metadata.reason: The current HWPX task and the existing Campus Energy Balance task are dissimilar in domain (Document Automation vs. Spreadsheet Calculation) and technology (XML/HWPX vs. Excel/Formulas), providing negligible transfer prior.

Both tasks involve template-based automation of HWPX documents, requiring XML manipulation of the package structure, handling fragmented placeholders in <hp:t> tags, and clearing <hp:lineSegArray> to prevent stale layout issues. The logic for replacing placeholders and managing the ZIP-based HWPX file format is highly transferable.
